pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawakkul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. A — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tawakkul; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Twahara; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Zakat:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Saum; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
